title: Consumer Sector Update for 08/01/2018: P,TCS,BGFV
text:

Consumer stocks were mostly lower Wednesday, including a more than 0.9% decline for shares of consumer staples companies in the S&P 500 while shares of consumer discretionary firms in the S&P 500 were sliding more than than 0.7% lower.
Among consumer stock moving Wednesday:
+ Pandora Media ( P ) was more than 15% higher, easing somewhat from a more than 23% increase earlier in the session, that followed the streaming music company reporting improved Q2 financial results compared with year-ago levels and also beating Wall Street estimates. Following the above-consensus Q2 earnings and revenue, analysts at RBC Capital Markets raised its stock rating for Pandora to Outperform from Sector Perform and increased their price target by $4 to $10 a share.
In other sector news:
+ Container Store ( TCS ) jumped to a 32-month high, topping out with a 43% increase to match its best share price since December 2015 at $9.50 each, after reporting a smaller fiscal Q1 net loss than analysts were expecting and above-consensus revenue for the three months ended June 30. It also raised its FY18 forecast to match with the Street view. Excluding one-time items, the company narrowed its Q1 net loss to $0.08 per share compared with the Capital IQ consensus looking for a $0.12 per share adjusted net loss, while revenue grew 6.9% year over year to $195.8 million, beating the Street view by $4.3 million.
- ( BGFV ) was more than 6% lower, recovering somewhat from a nearly 15% mid-morning decline, that followed the retailer reporting Q2 financial results trailing analyst projections, including a surprise net loss for the April-to-June period, and issued Q3 earnings guidance lagging Wall Street expectations by a wide margin.
